independent_reference.source: (1) Hand-derivation in tools/testkit/golden/derivations/boids-3agent-step1.md § 2 (every value substituted directly into the Reynolds-1987 formulae). (2) Reynolds, C. W. (1987), 'Flocks, herds and schools: A distributed behavioral model', SIGGRAPH '87, ACM SIGGRAPH Computer Graphics 21 (4), 25-34, DOI 10.1145/37401.37406, § 2 (separation, alignment, cohesion as defined verbatim). (3) Reynolds, C. W. (1999), 'Steering Behaviors for Autonomous Characters', GDC 1999, https://www.red3d.com/cwr/steer/ — the canonical weight set (w_s=1.5, w_a=1.0, w_c=1.0). Three independent published references converge on the closed-form post-step values shown.
independent_reference.derived_by: hand-derivation per Reynolds 1987 § 2; canonical weights per Reynolds 1999; Python generator script re-derives from the same formulae for end-to-end cross-check.
